title: A New Exciting Blend: Coffee with Tea | Simply Trini Cooking
ldIngredientsRaw: 1  tea bag (original recipe used Red Rose tea bag)
ldInstructionsRaw: Set the water in a kettle to boil. Pour the hot water into a teacup. Dip the tea bag into the water (about 8 times).
Then add 1 teaspoon of instant coffee. Stir until the coffee dissolves. Add sugar for taste. Serve hot.
htmlIngredientLines: 1 tea bag original recipe used Red Rose tea bag
